text.name: Blastoise

abilities.label: Pokémon Power
abilities.name: Rain Dance
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may attach 1 {Water} Energy card to 1 of your {Water} Pokémon. (This doesn't use up your 1 Energy card attachment for the turn.) This power can't be used if Blastoise is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each {Water} Energy attached to Blastoise but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. Extra {Water} Energy after the 2nd doesn't count.

text.flavor: A brutal Pokémon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high-speed tackles.

text.name: Pidgeotto

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Mirror Move
attacks.text: If Pidgeotto was attacked last turn, do the final result of that attack on Pidgeotto to the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: Very protective of its sprawling territory, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

text.name: Seel
text.flavor: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. This horn is used for bashing through thick ice.

text.name: Wartortle

attacks.name: Withdraw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Wartortle during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

text.flavor: Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. When swimming quickly, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

text.name: Pidgey

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

text.flavor: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

text.name: Squirtle

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Withdraw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Squirtle during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

text.flavor: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

text.name: Starmie

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.text: Discard 1 {Water} Energy card attached to Starmie in order to use this attack. Remove all damage counters from Starmie.

attacks.name: Star Freeze
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value this core as a gem.

text.name: Staryu
text.flavor: An enigmatic Pokémon that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

text.name: Computer Search
effect: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to search your deck for any card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

text.name: Pokémon Trader
effect: Trade 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards in your hand for 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards from your deck. Show both cards to your opponent. Shuffle your deck afterward.

text.name: Energy Removal
effect: Choose 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and discard it.

text.name: Switch
effect: Switch 1 of your Benched Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.
